metadata.name: rules_hook
metadata.description: Bordrless rules engine: one token hook that runs a rule set composed as data (at most 6 rules of conditions on a holding and one action each: a cut, a refusal, a count, a mark), bound to a launch config, and keeps each holding's 64-byte record in the Loss cover layout.

docs: Instructions of the rules engine.

instructions.name: before_burn
docs: `before_burn`: the burner's rules on `BURN` (no cuts: a cut on a burn is refused at
`bind`), its record written as for a send.

instructions.name: before_transfer
docs: `before_transfer`: the sender's rules, then the receiver's; one delta for the cuts; the
records of both sides written as the set keeps them.

instructions.name: bind
docs: Binds a rule set to `launch_config`, once: the bytes (checked as `validateRules` checks
them), the destination (the header's own) and, for a named destination, its wallet (on the
curve, not the default key; zeros are kept for any other destination). The config must name
this program with the flags the rules need and carry no kit rules, and the payer must be the
config's creator (`LaunchConfig.creator`, its author: the launchpad pays it the author share);
the SDK and the API bind in the transaction that makes the config, with that one signer.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent; recorded as the set's author.

accounts.name: launch_config
docs: The `LaunchConfig` the set is bound to (the launch program's).

instructions.name: prepare
docs: The Workshop template's `prepare` with the config's `RuleSet` as one more account: the
state for `mint` (which need not exist yet) with the rules copied in, the launch, the
launch pool and the cut's destination derived (the launch's reserve holding for burn, the
payer's holding for the creator, the named wallet's), and the registry. Anyone, once per
mint; `NoRules` when the account is not a bound `RuleSet`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent; the creator, for a creator destination.

accounts.name: rule_set
docs: checked in the handler: `NoRules` otherwise).

instructions.name: record_payout
docs: The companion's payout authority alone (the Loss cover hook's `record_payout`): records
`lamports` paid to `holding` (0: a touch) in round `tag`. The holding is of this mint, its
owner is eligible (a wallet on the curve, none of the launch, its pool or the cut's
destination owner) and it has a record; the record is written through the token program.

accounts.name: payout_authority
docs: The companion program's `PDA(["payout-authority"])`, signing by CPI.

accounts.name: holding
docs: `mint`; the token program writes its hook data.

errors.name: Length
errors.msg: A rule set is 8 bytes and then 48 for each rule.

errors.name: Version
errors.msg: The rule set’s version is not 1.

errors.name: RuleCount
errors.msg: A rule set has 1 to 6 rules.

errors.name: Keeps
errors.msg: The header’s keeps bits are entry, times and count only.

errors.name: Destination
errors.msg: The destination is none, burn, the creator or a named wallet.

errors.name: Side
errors.msg: A rule’s sides are some of sell, buy, send, receive and burn, at least one.

errors.name: Value
errors.msg: A condition reads one of the values the engine computes.

errors.name: Op
errors.msg: A condition compares with one of lt, le, gt, ge, eq and ne.

errors.name: Action
errors.msg: A rule’s action is a cut, a refusal, a count or a mark.

errors.name: Arg
errors.msg: A refusal’s reason is cooling, cap, locked or rule; a count adds or resets; a mark names a flag 0 to 3.

errors.name: WhenCount
errors.msg: A rule has at most 3 conditions.

errors.name: UnlessCount
errors.msg: A rule has at most one unless.

errors.name: Slot
errors.msg: A rule’s atom slots hold its conditions and its unless, in order, and nothing else.

errors.name: Literal
errors.msg: A threshold is within its unit’s bound: at most 10,000 basis points, 365 days, 10,000 SOL, the supply, or a count of 65,535.

errors.name: CutBps
errors.msg: A cut is 1 to 1,500 basis points; other actions carry none.

errors.name: CutOnBurn
errors.msg: A cut cannot be taken on a burn.

errors.name: CutDestination
errors.msg: A cut needs a destination: burn, the creator or a named wallet.

errors.name: SideTotal
errors.msg: The cuts on one side add up to at most 1,500 basis points.

errors.name: KeepsEntry
errors.msg: A condition on gain, loss or the entry price needs the set to keep an entry price.

errors.name: KeepsTimes
errors.msg: A condition on a time since receiving, sending, the first tokens or the holding’s age needs the set to keep times.

errors.name: KeepsCount
errors.msg: A count, a mark or a condition on one needs the set to keep a counter.

errors.name: EntryCap
errors.msg: The entry cap is 1 to 5,000 basis points and needs the set to keep an entry price.

errors.name: RefuseWhen
errors.msg: A refusal needs at least one condition.

errors.name: RefuseMarks
errors.msg: A refusal of a sell, a send or a burn must turn on time, amount, balance, share, price or value, not on a mark or the count alone.

errors.name: DestinationWallet
errors.msg: A named destination is a wallet on the curve, not the default key.

errors.name: ConfigHook
errors.msg: The config does not name the rules engine as its custom hook.

errors.name: ConfigFlags
errors.msg: The config’s hook flags are not the ones the rules need.

errors.name: ConfigKitRules
errors.msg: A composed config carries no kit rules.

errors.name: ConfigCreator
errors.msg: Only the config’s creator binds rules to it.

errors.name: CoolingDown
errors.msg: Refused by the token's rules: tokens that arrived too recently cannot move yet (cooling).

errors.name: OverCap
errors.msg: Refused by the token's rules: a wallet would hold more than the rules allow (cap).

errors.name: Locked
errors.msg: Refused by the token's rules: these tokens are locked for now (locked).

errors.name: Refused
errors.msg: Refused by the token's rules (rule).

errors.name: NoRules
errors.msg: No rule set is bound: the config names the rules engine but has no rules, so it cannot launch

errors.name: Unbound
errors.msg: This mint was prepared with another config's rules than the one it launched from

errors.name: WrongAccount
errors.msg: an account is not the one this mint's hook expects

errors.name: BadHookSigner
errors.msg: the hook signer is not the token program's signer for this hook

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: the holding is of another mint

errors.name: NotEligible
errors.msg: this owner holds no record: the launch, its pool, the cut's destination, the default key or an address off the ed25519 curve

errors.name: NotTheCompanion
errors.msg: only the companion program's payout authority records a payout

errors.name: NoRecord
errors.msg: this holding has no record to pay against

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: arithmetic overflow

types.name: Bound
docs: A rule set was bound to a config.

types.name: Delta
docs: One cut an answer takes from the amount.

fields.name: amount
docs: How much (above zero).

fields.name: account
docs: Index in the callback's account list (prefix first, then extras) of the holding that
receives it. Must be an extra.

types.name: HookReturn
docs: What a callback may answer in its return data. Which fields a callback may fill depends on the
callback and the flags ([`Allowed`]); the calling program refuses an answer that fills any
other field.

fields.name: deltas
docs: Cuts from the amount (the transfer; a swap's input before, its output after), at most
[`MAX_DELTAS`].

fields.name: burn
docs: Pool swap callbacks only: an amount to burn from the same side.

fields.name: lp_fee_bps
docs: `before_swap` only: the LP fee to apply instead of the pool's.

fields.name: source_hook_data
docs: Token callbacks only (`before_transfer`, `before_burn`): the source holding's new hook data
([`HOOK_DATA_LEN`] bytes).

fields.name: destination_hook_data
docs: Token callbacks only (`before_transfer`, `before_mint`): the destination holding's new hook
data.

types.name: LaunchConfig
docs: A launch config (`docs/hooks-v2.md` §5.7): the rules, the creator fee and, for a
build-your-own token, the creator's own token hook, made with the SDK by anyone as a keypair
account (so its key can be shared and pasted), fixed once created and usable for any number of
launches. `create_launch` takes one as an optional account; without one the rules come inline.
A config can never touch the protocol's share.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: creator
docs: Who made it.

fields.name: rules
docs: The token rules (within the launch config's bounds when made, checked again at launch).

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Creator fee on every swap, in basis points of the quote.

fields.name: custom_hook
docs: The creator's own token hook program (§5.8), when the config is for a build-your-own
token; then no kit module may be on (one token hook per mint). The mint is created with it
and no hook authority.

fields.name: custom_hook_flags
docs: The hook's flags (`bordrless_hook::token_flags`); 0 without a custom hook.

fields.name: label
docs: A short name, for the site.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation time.

fields.name: author_share_bps
docs: A listed config's author share (`create_listed_config`): the part of the creator fee, in
basis points of it (at most `MAX_AUTHOR_SHARE_BPS`), paid to `creator` (the config's
author) on every launch made from it by someone else. Fixed at creation; 0 for a config
made with `create_config`.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved. `reserved[0]` is [`LaunchConfig::TIMELOCKED_HOOK`] when the custom hook's upgrade
authority was its own `hook_timelock` when the config was made (phase 3a); 0 for every other
config, and for every config made before.

types.name: LaunchRules
docs: The rules a launch fixes for its token (`docs/hooks-v2.md` §5.1): what the pool hook takes on
each side, and the kit modules the token gets. Holder rewards are on when either holder fee is
above 0.

fields.name: holder_fee_buy_bps
docs: Holder fee on buys, from the quote input, paid to the holder vault.

fields.name: holder_fee_sell_bps
docs: Holder fee on sells, from the quote output after the protocol fee.

fields.name: burn_buy_bps
docs: Burn on buys, from the token output.

fields.name: burn_sell_bps
docs: Burn on sells, from the token input.

fields.name: max_wallet_bps
docs: Max wallet in basis points of the supply; 0 = off. Lifts at graduation.

fields.name: creator_lock_secs
docs: Creator wallet lock, counted from the launch; 0 = off.

fields.name: early_window_secs
docs: Early-buyer window, counted from the launch; 0 = off.

fields.name: early_lock_secs
docs: Early-buyer unlock, counted from the launch; above `early_window_secs` (0 when the lock is
off).

types.name: Phase
docs: Before or after the operation.

types.name: Prepared
docs: The engine was prepared for a mint.

fields.name: companion_creator
docs: The companion's creator address for the mint: exempt.

types.name: RuleSet
docs: The rule set bound to one `LaunchConfig`, at `["rules", config]`: 447 bytes.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version (1).

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump of `["rules", config]`.

fields.name: config
docs: The `LaunchConfig` it is bound to.

fields.name: author
docs: Who bound it.

fields.name: bound_at
docs: When.

fields.name: destination
docs: Where cuts go (the header's): 0 none, 1 burn, 2 the creator, 3 a named wallet.

fields.name: destination_wallet
docs: The named wallet; zeros otherwise.

fields.name: flags
docs: `flags_for(rules)`: the config's `custom_hook_flags`.

fields.name: hash
docs: sha256 of the bytes.

fields.name: len
docs: The bytes' length (`8 + 48 * rules`).

fields.name: rules
docs: The bytes, zero after `len`.

types.name: RulesState
docs: The engine's state for one mint, at `["state", mint]`: 628 bytes.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version (1).

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump of `["state", mint]`.

fields.name: launch
docs: The launch program's `["launch", mint]`: exempt.

fields.name: pool
docs: The launch pool at the launchpad's LP fee: exempt; the registry's third extra.

fields.name: config
docs: The `LaunchConfig` whose rules these are: a launch from any other config never trades.

fields.name: rule_set
docs: The `RuleSet` they were copied from.

fields.name: destination_holding
docs: Where cuts go (the default key without a destination).

fields.name: destination_owner
docs: Its owner: exempt.

fields.name: prepared_by
docs: Who sent `prepare` (the creator, for a creator destination), and when.

fields.name: reference
docs: Kept in the layout (§2.2) and always 0: entry prices are not capped against a reference.

fields.name: paid_total
docs: Lamports recorded by `record_payout`, and the records it wrote (touches included).

fields.name: flags
docs: The mint's hook flags, from the set.

fields.name: rules_len
docs: The rules' bytes, as bound.

fields.name: creator_bump
docs: Bump of the companion's `["creator", mint]`: its creator address, exempt (rules never touch
a companion's own trades: Snowball steps, buybacks, script sells).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

types.name: TokenHookArgs
docs: Arguments of a token hook callback. Balances and hook data are those of the holdings before
(`Before`) or after (`After`) the operation; `delta` is what the deltas took, known only after.

fields.name: op
docs: The operation.

fields.name: phase
docs: Before or after it.

fields.name: mint
docs: The mint.

fields.name: source
docs: Source holding (the mint for a mint).

fields.name: destination
docs: Destination holding (the mint for a burn).

fields.name: source_owner
docs: Owner of the source holding (default for a mint).

fields.name: destination_owner
docs: Owner of the destination holding (default for a burn).

fields.name: authority
docs: Who signed.

fields.name: authority_is_delegate
docs: Whether the signer acted as a delegate rather than the owner.

fields.name: amount
docs: The amount of the operation.

fields.name: delta
docs: The sum of the deltas a `before_transfer` answer took (zero before).

fields.name: source_balance
docs: Source balance.

fields.name: destination_balance
docs: Destination balance.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Decimals of the mint.

fields.name: supply
docs: Supply of the mint.

fields.name: source_hook_data
docs: The source holding's hook data (zeros for a mint).

fields.name: destination_hook_data
docs: The destination holding's hook data (zeros for a burn).

types.name: TokenOp
docs: What a token hook is being told about.
